properties.description: Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).
Manual commands follow level inputs with neutral conflict handling.
An arrived item stops before processing.
The acceptance interval is inclusive and its setpoint is linear.
No unqualified or unrelated scan changes the last accepted setpoint.
Output arrival and removal control the light.
Only the ordered processing route advances qualified products.

properties.formula: (G(auto) & G(arrival_pending -> F arrival) & G(processing_wait -> F matching_completion) & G(judged -> valid)) -> G(feed -> F light)
properties.description: With continuing automatic mode, eventual movement/processing feedback and accepted weights, each feed eventually completes.
Closes independent LTL coverage of manual/waiting/transport actuator behavior.

atomic_propositions.moving: pre-phase is a conveyor movement (MOVE_TO_WASH, MOVE_TO_WEIGHT, MOVE_TO_FIRING, or MOVE_TO_OUTPUT)
atomic_propositions.arrival: pre-phase moving AND corresponding destination sensor TRUE
atomic_propositions.judged: auto AND pre-phase WAIT_WEIGHT AND SensorWeight AND weightComplete
atomic_propositions.output_arrival: auto AND pre-phase MOVE_TO_OUTPUT AND SensorOutput
atomic_propositions.removed: auto AND pre-phase OUTPUT_DONE AND NOT SensorOutput
atomic_propositions.processing_wait: pre-phase is WAIT_WASH, WAIT_WEIGHT or WAIT_FIRING
atomic_propositions.matching_completion: matching station sensor and processing completion are TRUE in the corresponding wait
atomic_propositions.order: automatic route is FEED, WASH, WEIGHT, FIRING, OUTPUT; rejected weights cannot enter FIRING
atomic_propositions.MotorForward: O[k].MotorForward: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.MotorReverse: O[k].MotorReverse: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.kick: O[k].kick: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.CompletionLight: O[k].CompletionLight: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.firingTemp: O[k].firingTemp: independently observed post-scan candidate value (REAL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.post_wait: post-phase is WAIT_FEED, WAIT_WASH, WAIT_WEIGHT, or WAIT_FIRING
atomic_propositions.post_move: post-phase is MOVE_TO_WASH, MOVE_TO_WEIGHT, MOVE_TO_FIRING, or MOVE_TO_OUTPUT
